explication: TiDB is a distributed SQL database: applications submit SQL to a server, which compiles and executes queries using distributed storage and cluster services. The tree also contains major data-movement products: Dumpling exports data, Lightning imports it, and BR backs up and restores clusters; BR’s stream commands support log-based recovery workflows. The graph follows documented architecture and sampled source where available. Several subsystem connections are documented or indicated by the tree rather than verified from unsampled call sites.
